questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Explore new cultures

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: The most important thing for me was that it was an English-speaking country, as I wanted to improve my academic and professional English. At the same time, I was also looking for a university where I could choose from outside my normal field of study, as I wanted to try some social science subjects. In addition, it was a bonus that Scotland also has a lot of beautiful natural experiences, which I had been looking forward to.
